name: Chrome MCP (host browser)
description: Registers the chrome-devtools MCP server for Claude Code and Copilot CLI, driving an agent Chrome on the host through a socat tunnel.

hostAddr.description: Host name of the Docker host. Empty: host.rancher-desktop.internal when it resolves, else host.docker.internal.

hostPort.description: DevTools port of the agent Chrome on the host (start-agent-chrome.sh's CHROME_AGENT_PORT).

localPort.description: Port the tunnel listens on inside the container. Keep it different from hostPort.
